changes: 🎯 New: Leg Bets — fixed-odds betting on whether a person's next real group leg wins or loses. Syndy prices the odds from their real historical win rate (not the actual leg's real odds, since those aren't knowable until the result already is), fully automated, exposure-capped per side so a single bet can never threaten more than a bounded slice of the reserve. Resolves against their actual next real result once the Ledger records it — refunds everyone automatically if no result shows up within 9 days.
🔔 The chat icon now shows a real notification badge for unread Group Chat messages, not just the old weekly-checklist nag — clears the moment you open Group Chat.
